turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Cedar Ridge Dental Group · check-in · 2026-10-13

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (Director of Practice Operations), [PERSON_2] (Marketing Manager), [PERSON_3] (CSM, Healthcare)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2] joined for a 30-minute check-in. We covered the November openings for Meridian and Eagle, number provisioning, and two items they asked me to take back to the product team. Nothing else came up that needs attention before renewal.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Meridian and Eagle open November 9. [PERSON_4] to provision tracking numbers for both locations, one pool per office, plus separate numbers for the Google Ads and Meta campaigns so new-patient attribution stays clean. [PERSON_2] will send the campaign list and the practice manager contacts by Friday.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Practice managers at the 19 offices read the AI call summaries each morning before huddle. [PERSON_1] said that part is working fine for them.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Google Ads and Meta are the only platforms connected right now.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] is rolling out a short front-desk script for the two new offices so new-patient calls get tagged the same way as the existing sites.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Renewal is April 15, 2027. No action needed today.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] says new-patient call conversions are landing in Google Ads two days late, and their dental implant campaigns have pulled back spend since mid-September.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] asked for a way to turn off full transcripts for some offices and keep only redacted summaries, because front desk staff can see them.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Implant campaigns have been under-spending since mid-September. Google Ads is their main new-patient source, so slower conversions could soften November volume at the two new offices if it continues.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Front desk staff can currently see full transcripts. [PERSON_1] wants a narrower view before the new offices open, and she is the one signing off on the rollout.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: provision tracking numbers for Meridian and Eagle, confirm back to [PERSON_1] by October 23.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: send the campaign list and practice manager contacts to [PERSON_4] by October 16.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: take the Google Ads conversion timing issue to the product team and follow up with [PERSON_2] by October 27.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: take the transcript visibility request to the product team and follow up with [PERSON_1] by October 27.
